I work/live at Job Corps. Work from 7:00 AM to about 4:00 PM, can leave campus about once a week, get payed $11 a week, live in a room with 3-7 other guys, some of which don't bathe.
Even when you're off work, they still need volunteers to manage rooms, dorms, recreational facilities, student ran programs, etc., so many of us work from 7 AM to 8 PM with no pay raise. We are the janitors/secretaries for the facilities, and there's no system for pay when it comes to side stuff like that. Assuming you're off campus (on vacation or whatever), you're still under Job Corps rules, meaning you're technically not allowed to drink or have sex, even if you're 500 miles away.

It's all still worth it, just don't get the notion that it's "free" education. I can't blame all the hordes of people that fail; not all of us are comfortable selling away our freedom for security.
